'''Yorgraxx''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==History==
Over a [[Millennium/Legends|thousand]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Near-Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Quorlac Fornayh]] traveled to Yorgraxx and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the [[Unidentified Yorgraxx species|native]] [[Species/Legends|species]], using them to build [[Fornayh's fortress|his fortress]] before exterminating them. Within this fortress, Fornayh sought to create a new type of Sith [[mutant]]—the [[Coloi]]—in an attempt to overthrow the [[Sith Empire (disambiguation)|Sith Empire]] of his time during a conflict with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After this conflict began to turn in the Republic's favor, Fornayh retreated to his fortress, hoping to build up his forces and finish developing the Coloi creature.

During the Galactic Civil War, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]], ''[[Predator's Beak]]'' crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], which eventually reawakened the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of Fornayh. This created a disturbance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] which [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] felt on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and he sent [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Jallar Golin]] to Yorgraxx to investigate it. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] ship ''[[Griffon's Wings]]'' was attacked above the planet by Imperial [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruisers]] and crash-landed. The Rebel survivors joined forces with the survivors of the Imperial crash and defeated Fornayh's spirit in the fortress. Golin then arrived and encountered them.
